title: The Scarab Path
author: Tchaikovsky, Adrian
review:
This might be the best one yet, a lot of payoff on lore and character arcs that have been building up in the previous books in a cool new setting. Also think Tchaikovsky's prose was really nice in this one, had a lot of passages I wanted to highlight and think about.

The series is very military and action focused which at times I feel like I can get fatigued about it but overall the action is very cool and well written.

Looking forward to the next one quite a bit, back on the bugbook train, bugman take the wheel!
